text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(——A careful lookout is the basis of any good investigation… 
And this spot gives me a clear view of the school archive's 
entrance.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(I received special orders from the Disciplinary Committee the 
other day. My mission: To investigate the school archive.)

text_block_list.name: Disciplinary Committee Umamusume
text_block_list.text: We've had students sneaking into the archive room recently. Multiple students. This is despite the fact the door is locked to protect the precious documents inside…

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Why, that's criminal trespassing! We cannot afford to have those 
documents damaged. It is our duty as the Disciplinary Committee 
to prevent a disaster before it happens!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Who are the trespassers? How are they entering the archives? 
What are their motives? If I am to maintain public order in the 
academy, I need to find the answer to these questions!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(The instant I spot someone engaging in suspicious activity, 
I will begin questioning! Now, come at me, intruders!)
Event logo.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(That's odd… Not a single student is passing by, much less 
an intruder!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Passing By
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, Fenomeno alert. Aw man, look how she's glaring… 
If she sees me, she's gonna be on my case about dress code… 
…Yeah, no thanks. I'm taking the other stairs.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ……Wait… Is no one passing through here… Because of me!?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Fenomeno-chan! 
Heyyyy, what's up?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: So that's why you're on watch. The archive room… That's the one they keep locked up, right? Right next door to the school library——

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
Hang on… The library? Say, I don't know if this has anything 
to do with your thing… But I saw Buu-chan acting funny in there.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You mean Narita Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: Yep. Buu-chan was all the way in the back, and she never goes back there. I asked what she was up to, but she was all "I don't need to tell you."

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
But that just made me curious! 
So I kept bugging her about it, and eventually she tapped out.

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
She was like "You really don't know when to quit," 
and finally told me what she was up to!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You managed to get an answer out of Brian-san!? So, what was she doing there?

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text: "I tried taking a nap there. Couldn't fall asleep with the rest making all that noise."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"The rest"…? That is an intriguing choice of words. 
I'd like to ask Brian-san a few questions… But we should take 
stock of the back of the library first!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, ma'am, you are on librarian duty, correct? 
Would you mind if I asked you a few questions? The Disciplinary 
Committee has a tip from an anonymous source that——

text_block_list.name: School Librarian Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eek! I'm s-s-s-s-s-sorry, I'm not slacking off, honest! 
I'm just, uh, double-checking the manga section! I'm going to 
go put this book back where it belongs, so, um, goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Timid-looking Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I- I'm sorry! I tried to get away with returning an overdue book 
without telling anyone! 
I swear I'll never do it again… Please, forgive meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
N-no, I'm not trying to blame you… W-wait, please!! 
Argh… I can't even get a word in!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
What's going on, Fenomeno-san? 
Is something wrong? 
Was there someone you wanted to talk to?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, miss librarian. What's the back of the library like? 
Someone said there's a super nice napping spot back there!

text_block_list.name: School Librarian Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, a napping spot? Who'd you hear that from? I wish there was something like that. Unfortunately, it's just more books back there.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Really? …Aww. 
But wouldn't it be so fun if there was a secret room back there? 
Like a secret hideout!

text_block_list.name: School Librarian Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It sure would be. Actually, now that you mention it… 
There is a secret passage back there, kind of. Nobody uses 
it anymore, but there's a door leading to the archive room.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wowie, there's a secret door!? 
I wonder what it's like… I'm gonna go look for it! 
Thanks, miss librarian!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
U-Urara-san…! You managed to extract new information just 
by chatting with her… 
You're a natural investigator!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
You deserve a medal!! 
That door is a solid lead on their method for sneaking into the 
archives!

text_block_list.name: Samson Big
text_block_list.text:
So Buu-chan wanted to take a nap in the archive room, 
but "the rest" were too noisy, so she left?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Which means Brian-san is not one of our culprits. 
Then we should focus our efforts on the passage between 
the library and archive room!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ——D-did I hear you right!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Hm? Biko-san? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I was tailing Windy-senpai just now, since she looked like she 
was planning another one of her schemes. 
But then I lost track of her…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That happened in the back of the library! 
She might've used that secret passage too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!? I'm going to borrow the archive key! 
We may be able to catch her in the act!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm going too! 
I wanna find out what Windy-senpai's up to!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Muahaha… If I just put this cloth above the entrance… 
Whatever sucker comes in here's gonna get it right on 
their head!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This place is perfect for playing pranks! 
I'll never get busted so long as I use that secret door～♪

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I see… So you entered through a hidden passage instead of 
simply asking to borrow the key? 
You've just admitted to criminal trespass.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: CAUGHT YOU RED-HANDED! YOU'RE UNDER ARREST!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: !!?!? H-how… HOW'D YOU CATCH ME!?!!???
